decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter was featured on the home page and is infrastructure for the firm's modular track system, so its visible commitment and centrality to the flexible-lighting direction make management persist with it.

This LED luminaire line was only mentioned rather than showcased, which makes it more expendable, but its fit with the announced ecological LED direction and the sunk development costs favour keeping it, with weak results attributed to temporary market conditions.

The home automation server box anchors the firm's publicly stated home automation strategy, so despite modest visibility management would justify the investment and persist, blaming slow uptake on an immature smart-home market.
The luminaire family received a dedicated page and multi-model investment close to the core offer, so prior commitment and the need to justify that decision make management keep it.
